messages:
Taylor: Hi team, I'm Taylor (joined today) and hitting a wall on cloud access. Need to run the onboarding CI which needs: GCP project `staging-redwood-42` read + `iam.serviceAccountUser` on `ci-runner-sa@staging-redwood-42.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, and to assume AWS role `arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/ReadOnlyOps` to check S3 logs. Tried opening the project console and got 403 on IAM page. Who owns these grants?

Priya: Welcome Taylor! For GCP we need the project ID, your @redwood email, and the SA email you want to impersonate. For AWS we need your IAM principal (org SSO user or federated identity). Does the 403 happen on the IAM -> Permissions page or while visiting Cloud Console overall?

Taylor: It's specifically IAM -> Permissions. Error: "You do not have permission to view this page (403)". My email is taylor@redwood.com. SA is `ci-runner-sa@staging-redwood-42.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. AWS SSO user is `redwood/taylor`.

Devon: I own the staging folder. Quick heads up: staging-redwood-42 is under folder `staging-team` which has an org constraint blocking `asia-southeast1` and `ap-southeast-2` spots. Also we've recently tightened who can view IAM due to a policy; only group `infra-iam-viewers` has access. I can add you to infra-iam-viewers for read-only so you can see bindings. Do you need to create keys or just impersonate SA via `gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account`?

Taylor: Only impersonation for CI, no keys. CI runs from GitHub Actions in APAC runner, so we need at least APAC compute access to start a small ephemeral VM and test latency. Is adding me to infra-iam-viewers enough for that?

Devon: Not by itself — compute location whitelists are separate. Two paths: 1) move the project to a folder with APAC allowed (requires approvals), or 2) apply a temporary project-level exception to `constraints/restrictResourceLocations` to include `asia-southeast1` for 48 hours. I can request an exception. Which do you prefer?

Taylor: Temporary exception is fine for now. Also for AWS assume-role can someone verify the role trust policy allows SSO principal `arn:aws:iam::222333444555:saml-provider/Okta` or our SSO role? I tried `aws sts assume-role` and got "AccessDenied".

Priya: For AWS we usually add new-hires to group `redwood-readonly-crossacct` which is allowed in the role's trust policy. Devon, can you check the trust policy or ping cloud-security?

Devon: Will check. In the meantime Taylor, run these checks and paste outputs (redact tokens):

```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy staging-redwood-42 --format=json

gcloud beta resource-manager folders get-iam-policy FOLDER_ID --format=json

aws sts get-caller-identity && aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/ReadOnlyOps --role-session-name taylor-onboard-test
```

Taylor: Pasted outputs: GCP project policy shows role bindings only to `group:staging-admins@redwood.com`. Folder IAM shows constraint `constraints/restrictResourceLocations: [europe-west1, europe-west4]`. AWS assume-role returned `An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User is not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole`.

Devon: OK that's consistent. I'll open ticket CLOUD-8472 to request: add taylor@redwood.com to `infra-iam-viewers`, add `asia-southeast1` to project allowed locations for 48h, and verify/update the AWS role trust to include `redwood/taylor` or add you to `redwood-readonly-crossacct`. @ops-bot can you create the ticket and set priority P2?

ops-bot: Ticket CLOUD-8472 created: "Onboard Taylor: GCP IAM view + APAC exception + AWS assume-role". Assigned to infra and cloud-security. Priority: P2. ETA: 1 business day. :robot_face:

billing-team: FYI billing approval not required for a 48h resource location exception, but if you plan sustained APAC usage please open a billing-change request so quotas and budgets can be adjusted.

Taylor: Thanks everyone. I can wait for the ticket. One ask: once infra adds me to `infra-iam-viewers`, can someone confirm the `iam.serviceAccountUser` permission is granted to `taylor@redwood.com` on the SA? Otherwise GitHub Actions won't be able to impersonate.

Devon: Will include that in CLOUD-8472. I'll update here when the group and exception are in place.

Taylor: Great, appreciate the quick help. I'll paste CI logs here once I try again. :wave:
